title: Reactor theorized as a cyclotron hitting element 115

tellings.quote: So, it was theorized apparently Barry with his other lab partner, they thought that was a cyclotron, an accelerator.

plain: The reactor in an alien craft at S4, a secret site in Nevada, was thought to work like a cyclotron, a kind of particle accelerator, shooting particles at element 115, a very heavy chemical element. Bob Lazar, who says he worked on such craft at S4 from 1987 to 1989, tells Michels this was the idea of a co-worker, Barry Castilio, and Castilio's lab partner: "they thought that was a cyclotron, an accelerator."
